items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: The interviewee mentions Stan Getz only in the context of him opening a club and playing there, with no indication of personal interaction or professional collaboration with the interviewee.

ctx.x: Well what band has drawn the best in Copenhagen of all the bands you've had in the Montmartre?

George's band, in the Montmartre, if you want to refer to that particular place. Yeah, that particular place. Yes. I mean George's band was outstanding. I haven't seen anything like it in the traditional field. Speaking about progressive and modern jazz, when Stan Getz and Moe's Allison opened the club, just after George and the band were there, there was a lot of people too.
So would you say Stan Getz and Moe's Allison at Drew George?
